name: Change Task Status
description: The user updates a task's status (Todo, In Progress, Done) directly from the task list without opening the Task Form.
preconditions: The Task List screen is visible
At least one task exists in the list

main_flow.description: Changes the status of a task directly in the list
Updates the status badge for that task in the list

alternative_flows.name: Status update fails
alternative_flows.trigger: At step 2, the status cannot be saved
steps: Task status reverts to its previous value

postconditions: The task's status is updated and reflected in the list
business_rules: Status can be changed directly from the list without opening the edit form
Valid statuses are: Todo, In Progress, Done

bdd_scenarios.given: The user is on the Task List screen and at least one task exists
bdd_scenarios.when: The user changes the status of a task directly in the list
bdd_scenarios.then: The task's status badge updates to reflect the new status

bdd_scenarios.given: The user is on the Task List screen and at least one task exists
bdd_scenarios.when: The user changes the status of a task but the update cannot be saved
bdd_scenarios.then: An error notification is displayed and the task status reverts to its previous value

bdd_scenarios.scenario: Change Task Status — invalid status value
bdd_scenarios.given: The user is on the Task List screen and at least one task exists
bdd_scenarios.when: The user attempts to change a task's status to a value outside Todo, In Progress, or Done
bdd_scenarios.then: The system rejects the change and the task status remains unchanged
